$comment: The action object for one turn of ask mode (read-only Q&A). Flat and every string bounded, for the reasons in prompts/README.md, and `required` again lists every string field because Ollama enforces the top-level list and nothing else useful. The important line is the `tool` enum: it is three values, and `edit` is not one of them. Read-only is enforced at the decoder rather than at dispatch, so the model cannot emit a write action even malformed.

reasoning.$comment: Two sentences. Bounded because latency is output length.

answer.$comment: About 375 tokens, which at 25.3 tok/s decode is fifteen seconds of answer. Longer answers are not better ones and this is the single most expensive field in the mode.

citations.$comment: `path:line` or `path:start-end`, comma separated, or the literal `none` when the model is declining to answer. A string rather than an array of objects: nesting is what produced empty actions when it was tried on the edit schema, and the harness can parse commas.
